metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `output/`, with executable `output/build/bibtex` and [usage documentation](/workspace/output/README.md).

```sh
cd output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

Build and tests pass, covering all four canonical styles, macros, crossrefs, names, wrapping, AUX input, and JSON diagnostics. Uses only the C++ standard library.

submission_command = ('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/bibtex-build0/build/bibtex',)
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_format_name_out_of_range0')

    def test_format_name_out_of_range(submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        """A positive past-end index retains the final name scanned by BibTeX."""
        # bibtex.web, "Isolate the desired name": scanning stops at the end
        # of the list, leaving the last name selected, and emits a warning.
        # Only the selected name is observed here: the public JSON warning
        # catalog does not prescribe a distinct kind for this condition.
        bib = '@article{a, author = "John Smith"}\n'
        bbl, _ = _iterate(
            submission_command,
            tmp_path,
            'author #2 "{ll}" format.name$ "|" * write$',
            bib=bib,
            entry_fields="author",
        )
>       assert bbl.strip() == "Smith|"
E       AssertionError: assert '|' == 'Smith|'
E         
E         - Smith|
E         + |

/tmp/tests/test_builtins_exhaustive.py:551: AssertionError

submission_command = ('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/bibtex-build0/build/bibtex',)
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_trailing_whitespace_remov0')

    def test_trailing_whitespace_removed_on_short_line(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """bibtex.web output_bbl_line trims trailing whitespace on every flush."""
        body = '"abc   " write$ newline$'
        bbl = _run(submission_command, tmp_path, body)
>       assert bbl == "abc\n"  # bibtex.web output_bbl_line strips trailing whitespace.
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

E         
E         - abc
E         + abc

submission_command = ('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/bibtex-build0/build/bibtex',)
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_pending_write_is_discarde0')

    def test_pending_write_is_discarded_at_end_of_run(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """WEB's bst_done closes the BBL without draining the logical buffer."""
        # bibtex.web 3478–3483 goes directly from BST EOF to closing files;
        # write$ (11288–11300) only adds to out_buf. Only wrapping/newline$
        # call output_bbl_line. The public authority notice gives WEB precedence
        # over summary §3.6's contradictory MUST-flush statement, just as for
        # its contradictory trailing-whitespace rule. A flushed prefix prevents
        # an implementation that produces no output from passing this test.
        body = '"flushed" write$ newline$ "pending" write$'
>       assert _run(submission_command, tmp_path, body) == "flushed\n"
E       AssertionError: assert 'flushed\npending' == 'flushed\n'
E         
E           flushed
E         + pending

/tmp/tests/test_output_buffer.py:266: AssertionError

submission_command = ('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/bibtex-build0/build/bibtex',)
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_whitespace_only_line_is_d0')

    def test_whitespace_only_line_is_discarded_on_flush(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        # bibtex.web output_bbl_line returns without a newline if a nonempty
        # buffer becomes empty after trailing-whitespace trimming. Neighboring
        # content makes successful output observable, separate from no output.
        body = '"A" write$ newline$ "   " write$ newline$ "B" write$ newline$'
>       assert _run(submission_command, tmp_path, body) == "A\nB\n"

E         
E           A
E         +    
E           B
